sections.content: How many people are "boat and ship builders and repairers"?

9,705 people

were counted on the census as "boat and ship builders and repairers" in England and Wales in March 2021.

Boat and ship builders and repairers construct, install and repair wooden structures and fittings, and shape, position, rivet and seal metal plates and girders to form the metal structures and frameworks for marine craft.

More men than women had this job

Among people working as "boat and ship builders and repairers" there were more men than women (96.9% compared with 3.1%).

This means "boat and ship builders and repairers" had a similar proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "skilled metal, electrical and electronic trades".

Men made up 96.9% and women made up 3.1% of "boat and ship builders and repairers"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "boat and ship builders and repairers" included:

  • rail and rolling stock builders and repairers
  • construction operatives (other)
  • security system installers and repairers

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

People who had this job were generally similar in age to the working population

The occupation of "boat and ship builders and repairers" had a similar age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 25 to 29 years. Of the whole working population 11.1% were aged 25 to 29 years. For people working as "boat and ship builders and repairers", 12% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "boat and ship builders and repairers" was 16 to 19 years.

sections.content:
Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "boat and ship builders and repairers" included:

  • groundsmen and greenkeepers
  • other elementary services occupations
  • care workers and home carers

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "boat and ship builders and repairers", 7.7% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had a similar age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (91.1% compared with 8.9%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (80%) than self-employed (20%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the South West. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Plymouth, this is in the same region of the South West.
